p: all Israel with him: For such is the inconstancy of the people, that for the most part they follow the vices of their governors.
Sukkiims: Who were a people of Africa called the Troglodytes because they lived in holes.
therefore have I also left you: Signifying that no calamity can come to us unless we forsake God, and that he never leaves us till we have cast him off.
righteous: Therefore he justly punishes you for your sins.

service: He shows that God's punishments are not to utterly destroy his, but to chastise them, to bring them to the knowledge of themselves, and to know how much better it is to serve God than tyrants.
humbled himself: Which declares that God does not seek the death of a sinner, but his conversion, Eze 18:32.
seventeen years in Jerusalem: That is, twelve years after he had been overcome by Shishak, 2Ch 12:2.
